title: Section 3 image evidence, fields, frames, texture, and topology
description: Artifact contracts and complete typed ports for the 27 mechanisms in Section 3 of the v4 mechanism census. Type matches express candidate semantic compatibility only, not bindings, dependencies, architecture, or build order.

artifactTypes.label: Native opaque sRGB8 raster
artifactTypes.description: The once-decoded, native-dimension, three-channel opaque 8-bit sRGB raster with no resampling.
sourceNotes: This is the fixed left product anchor and the NativeRaster output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:82-96.
provenanceNotes: Native dimensions, pixel order, source hash, and decode identity remain available through paired custody metadata.

artifactTypes.label: Native OKLab pixel raster
artifactTypes.description: One floating OKLab triple for every native source pixel in unchanged pixel order and cardinality.
sourceNotes: Produced by color.oklab-working-space from the native opaque raster and required by family quantization, robust native fitting, and continuous surround mechanisms.
provenanceNotes: Must retain the native raster identity and one-to-one pixel correspondence; it is not a working-raster conversion.

artifactTypes.label: Max-edge-224 Lanczos3 sRGB8 working raster
artifactTypes.description: A three-channel opaque sRGB8 discovery raster resized with the historical max-edge-224 Lanczos3 policy and distinct from native source truth.
sourceNotes: The historical region-graph and SLIC path used this exact max-edge-224 Lanczos3 working raster; current runtime use remains prohibited by the native/no-resampling policy.
provenanceNotes: Carries source identity, working dimensions, kernel, orientation, color conversion, and flattening policy; it must never be substituted for the native raster type.

artifactTypes.label: Declared discovery-raster OKLab samples
artifactTypes.description: OKLab samples on an explicitly declared non-native discovery lattice.
sourceNotes: Produced by color.oklab-working-space only for an explicitly declared non-native discovery lattice and admitted as a distinct robust-fit alternative.
provenanceNotes: Must bind its source raster, lattice, sampling, and color-conversion identities and cannot claim native-pixel cardinality.

artifactTypes.label: Native scalar intensity plane
artifactTypes.description: A scalar image plane on the native lattice with a declared channel or intensity conversion.
sourceNotes: Required by the noise, grayscale morphology, and scalar texture formulations; Section 3 does not provide the scalar conversion.
provenanceNotes: The conversion, range, lattice, boundary policy, and native raster identity must be explicit.

artifactTypes.label: Packed RGB color-count observations
artifactTypes.description: A flattened ordered sequence of distinct packed RGB values and nonnegative population counts.
sourceNotes: Legacy k-means, elbow, and gap implementations consume repeated color,count pairs; histogram formation is not a Section 3 mechanism.
provenanceNotes: Observation order is consequential to initialization and ties; counts preserve full weighted population.

artifactTypes.label: Color-space distance configuration
artifactTypes.description: A named color representation with distance, conversion, and identity-tolerance behavior used by legacy color measurements.
sourceNotes: Legacy k-means assignment, nearest-observation publication, and local-contrast saliency depend on a supplied color-space implementation.
provenanceNotes: Distance identity and version must be retained because assignment may use a different space from packed-RGB centroid updates.

artifactTypes.label: Requested legacy k-means K
artifactTypes.description: The requested positive cluster count and fixed iteration policy for one legacy k-means run.
sourceNotes: The implementation may reduce K when too few distinct colors exist and stops at convergence or 100 iterations.
provenanceNotes: Requested K remains distinct from effective k in the result statistic.

artifactTypes.label: Public legacy k-means observed-color map
artifactTypes.description: The returned map from observed representative packed RGB colors to full weighted cluster populations.
sourceNotes: This is the public k-means/election output; it does not expose cluster memberships, synthesized means, selected K, WCSS points, or slopes.
provenanceNotes: Duplicate observed representative keys can overwrite earlier clusters; values do not include native pixel witnesses.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy k-means WCSS and effective k
artifactTypes.description: Population-normalized within-cluster squared distance and the effective cluster count for one run.
sourceNotes: Returned alongside the public observed-color map by the direct k-means implementation.
provenanceNotes: Binds requested K, effective k, distance implementation, input observation identity, and implementation behavior.

artifactTypes.label: Internal legacy k-means cluster state
artifactTypes.description: Non-public observation-to-cluster memberships together with packed-RGB weighted mean centers.
sourceNotes: Mechanically formed inside legacy k-means but explicitly not returned in its public result; the separate publication mechanism therefore retains this as an unresolved required handoff.
provenanceNotes: Preserves input observation order, membership indices, mean centers, empty-cluster invalidity, and convergence state; it is not the public cluster map.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy elbow election policy
artifactTypes.description: Early and late K sets plus outlier, regression, synthetic-endpoint, ceiling, and tie behavior for slope-intersection election.
sourceNotes: Defaults are early [1,2,3,4] and late [50,100]; mutable closure state is part of implemented behavior.
provenanceNotes: Configuration identity must include malformed cleaned-regression and repeated-call behavior when describing the live implementation.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy gap election policy
artifactTypes.description: Minimum and maximum K plus gap maximization and single-reference-draw behavior.
sourceNotes: Describes the implemented legacy election, not a corrected standard gap-statistic formulation.
provenanceNotes: Binds minK, maxK, logarithm behavior, maximizing tie behavior, and reference draw count.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy gap reference generator model
artifactTypes.description: The built-in reference-distribution generator used for legacy gap comparisons.
sourceNotes: The live generator samples packed RGB code order and contains the documented flattened-pair indexing defect.
provenanceNotes: Model identity must distinguish this invalid implementation from any corrected color-space bounding-box reference distribution.

artifactTypes.label: Observed legacy cluster representative
artifactTypes.description: One assigned observed packed RGB color nearest to a synthesized cluster mean, paired with the cluster's weighted population.
sourceNotes: Represents the publication step per mean cluster; it is not a native exact-pixel publication witness.
provenanceNotes: Retains mean-state identity, assigned observation order, nearest-distance tie behavior, and full weighted population.

artifactTypes.label: OKLab family grid configuration
artifactTypes.description: Fine-grid step, origin, boundary, representative, and deterministic tie policies for native color-family quantization.
sourceNotes: The inherited historical step was 0.04 and is not independently derived.
provenanceNotes: Grid identity must distinguish source-preserving family assignment from mean-emitting quantization.

artifactTypes.label: Native color-family label plane
artifactTypes.description: One deterministic fine-grid OKLab family label per native pixel.
sourceNotes: Primary spatial output of evidence.family-quantization and input to four-connected family components.
provenanceNotes: Retains native lattice, grid policy, family identity, and exact source-pixel correspondence.

artifactTypes.label: Native color-family records
artifactTypes.description: Finite family records with occupancy, prototype, components when available, and exact representative options.
sourceNotes: Family records preserve stable color grouping without granting field, figure, or role semantics.
provenanceNotes: Prototype values remain distinct from exact representative options and native witnesses.

artifactTypes.label: Native binary family support mask
artifactTypes.description: A native-lattice binary mask for exactly one declared color family.
sourceNotes: May be materialized from the family label plane for support and scale-space measurements.
provenanceNotes: Binds family identity, native dimensions, membership policy, exact population, and mask hash.

artifactTypes.label: Native binary candidate support mask
artifactTypes.description: A frozen native-lattice binary mask for one declared candidate rather than a family union.
sourceNotes: Native mask scale-space accepts candidate masks as distinct from family masks; candidate availability formation is outside this Section 3 mapping.
provenanceNotes: Requires frozen candidate identity, native witness, native dimensions, exact population, and mask hash.

artifactTypes.label: Native four-connected family components
artifactTypes.description: Deterministically ordered four-connected components within native color-family labels, with membership and geometry.
sourceNotes: Exposes spatial support for color families without asserting one semantic object per component.
provenanceNotes: Retains family ID, scan order, neighbor order, connectivity, pixel membership, bounds, and native raster identity.

artifactTypes.label: SLIC region policy
artifactTypes.description: Region-count, compactness, iteration, connectivity-cleanup, and exact-representative policies for SLIC-style aggregation.
sourceNotes: Historical controls yielded roughly 48-320 regions and version 0.19 did not connectivity-clean labels.
provenanceNotes: Must bind the working-raster identity and preserve whether connectivity cleanup was absent.

artifactTypes.label: Working-raster SLIC label plane
artifactTypes.description: One SLIC-style region label per pixel on the declared working raster lattice.
sourceNotes: This label plane is working-raster evidence and is unsuitable as an assumed connectivity-clean segmentation API in historical 0.19.
provenanceNotes: Retains working dimensions, source and resize identity, region policy, and exact label ordering.

artifactTypes.label: SLIC region adjacency graph
artifactTypes.description: Perceptual-spatial region records and their adjacency, boundary, border, variance, saliency, and text evidence on a working lattice.
sourceNotes: Aggregates pixels into regions but does not decide whether grain is material or grant segmentation authority.
provenanceNotes: Binds label plane, adjacency construction, working raster, region attributes, and ordering.

artifactTypes.label: SLIC exact source representatives
artifactTypes.description: Exact source representative records associated with working-raster SLIC regions.
sourceNotes: Keeps representative custody separate from interpolated working-raster values and from region labels.
provenanceNotes: Each record must identify its region, source raster, representative selection rule, and source location or explicitly bounded historical custody.

artifactTypes.label: Normalized image-coordinate policy
artifactTypes.description: Declared border bands, side and corner conventions, interior domain, and normalized coordinate formulas.
sourceNotes: Border/frame ownership measurements require explicit normalized coordinate and null-domain behavior.
provenanceNotes: Binds lattice dimensions, border width, corner definitions, side order, and empty-interior behavior.

artifactTypes.label: Border and frame ownership diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Border coverage, per-side coverage, corner count, interior ownership, and border-versus-interior excess for one support source.
sourceNotes: These values are evidence and never field authority by themselves.
provenanceNotes: Retains support identity, coordinate policy, denominators, threshold if any, and explicit undefined states.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy local-contrast saliency policy
artifactTypes.description: Radius-3 maximum color distance, three-tap separable blur, scale-relative max dilation, and maximum normalization policy.
sourceNotes: Describes the live fixed-radius implementation, not Itti-Koch center-surround saliency or local variance.
provenanceNotes: Binds radius, kernel, border clamping, dilation-radius formula, normalization, and output quantization.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy local-contrast saliency map
artifactTypes.description: An 8-bit maximum-normalized local color-contrast field at the input raster cardinality.
sourceNotes: Live root saliency output; large objects may be represented mostly by their edges and absolute magnitude is lost.
provenanceNotes: Retains raster identity, dimensions, distance configuration, policy identity, and 8-bit normalization behavior.

artifactTypes.label: Otsu saliency threshold
artifactTypes.description: One integer threshold in [0,255] maximizing between-class variance for an 8-bit map.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Expose the unused Otsu helper result as a diagnostic without attributing it to the live saliency path.
sourceNotes: The formula is implemented but has no live call site in the cited saliency worker.
provenanceNotes: Retains histogram, map identity, tie behavior, empty-class handling, and integer result.

artifactTypes.label: Native exact-color support mask
artifactTypes.description: A native binary mask identifying every exact occurrence of one declared source RGB color.
sourceNotes: One alternative support input; Section 3 does not define exact-color mask formation.
provenanceNotes: Binds exact RGB, native raster identity, dimensions, population, and mask hash.

artifactTypes.label: Population, connectivity, and spread vector
artifactTypes.description: Mass and geometry measurements including exact population, local same-color mass, connected share, family concentration, spread, and observation breadth.
sourceNotes: Report-only support evidence under v3; it is not a belonging or validity gate.
provenanceNotes: Every value retains its exact denominator, source mask, native raster, neighborhood definition, and null behavior.

artifactTypes.label: Component-local raster measurements
artifactTypes.description: Per-component edge, contrast, variance, geometry, repetition, polarity, compactness, and stroke-width measurements.
sourceNotes: Structural text-shape interpretation requires these measurements, but Section 3 contains no single mechanism that provides the complete vector.
provenanceNotes: Retains component identity, raster identity, local neighborhood, formulas, scale normalization, and unavailable cues.

artifactTypes.label: Component typography and signature evidence
artifactTypes.description: Uncertain per-component evidence for title-like typography or signature marks, without assigning a text label or UI role.
sourceNotes: Output of the bounded structural text-shape mechanism; remains distinct from root foreground colors and pixel-retention diagnostics.
provenanceNotes: Retains source component, cue values, cue availability, uncertainty, and method identity.

artifactTypes.label: Optional structural text-chain hypotheses
artifactTypes.description: Optional uncertain chains of components that may form typography-like marks without OCR or text authority.
sourceNotes: Semantically different from the two legacy text-region pixel buffers and from scored root foreground-color hypotheses.
provenanceNotes: Retains member components, ordering, grouping policy, uncertainty, and explicit absence when no chain is formed.

artifactTypes.label: Declared field-color hypothesis
artifactTypes.description: One uncertain field-color hypothesis supplied to contrastive root foreground heuristics.
sourceNotes: The root structural-text heuristic requires a field color; its election is outside this Section 3 mechanism.
provenanceNotes: Must retain source color custody, hypothesis method, confidence or abstention semantics, and raster identity.

artifactTypes.label: Foreground contrast-floor configuration
artifactTypes.description: A declared color-contrast function and minimum foreground contrast used by root foreground hypotheses.
sourceNotes: Required by legacy structural-text heuristic scoring and fallback behavior.
provenanceNotes: Binds contrast algorithm, direction, threshold, comparison semantics, and version.

artifactTypes.label: Legacy root foreground-color hypotheses
artifactTypes.description: Several independently scored foreground color hypotheses with method identities, scores, and fallback states.
sourceNotes: Produced for comparison by the live root caller; this is not a text mask, OCR result, reviewed joint model, or elected complete treatment.
provenanceNotes: Retains method name, source cluster map, saliency threshold, field color, contrast floor, score, and fallback reason.

artifactTypes.label: Fixed-threshold text-rectangle retention buffer
artifactTypes.description: A full-size RGB buffer retaining source pixels inside grouped scanline rectangles and zeroing other positions.
sourceNotes: Output of the inactive fixed-threshold scanline route; rectangle filling includes non-text pixels.
provenanceNotes: Retains native input coordinates, grayscale and inversion policy, rectangle grouping order, dimensions, and channel count.

artifactTypes.label: Packed fixed-threshold rectangle pixels
artifactTypes.description: A packed source-pixel buffer containing pixels from grouped fixed-threshold rectangles without a full-size lattice.
sourceNotes: Semantically and structurally distinct from the full-size rectangle buffer and adaptive contour outputs.
provenanceNotes: Retains source offsets, rectangle order, channel count, allocated length behavior, and originating full-size raster identity.

artifactTypes.label: Adaptive text-contour retention buffer
artifactTypes.description: A full-size RGB buffer retaining source pixels only at adaptive-threshold morphology/Sobel contour locations.
sourceNotes: Live visual diagnostic output; contours are not filled text masks and have no semantic text authority.
provenanceNotes: Retains adaptive threshold, 5x5 opening/closing, Sobel threshold, eight-connectivity, border handling, dimensions, and contour order.

artifactTypes.label: Packed adaptive contour pixels
artifactTypes.description: A packed source-pixel buffer containing adaptive morphology/Sobel contour pixels without a full-size lattice.
sourceNotes: Distinct from fixed-threshold rectangle pixels and from component-level typography hypotheses.
provenanceNotes: Retains contour order, source offsets, channel count, documented double channel multiplication in allocation, and originating raster identity.

artifactTypes.label: Native mask scale-space target attribution
artifactTypes.description: A declared max-edge or pixel-budget target with exact target dimensions, box-filter, sampling, Q0.24, and hash policies.
sourceNotes: Target attribution distinguishes max-edge from pixel-budget policies and does not mean semantic or human attribution.
provenanceNotes: Binds requested value, actual dimensions, SAT/BigInt box filter, half-up Q0.24 rounding, exact center sampling, and typed hashes.

artifactTypes.label: Native Q0.24 low-pass support plane
artifactTypes.description: A centered-box low-pass field over one frozen binary mask, stored on the native lattice in unsigned Q0.24.
sourceNotes: Derived diagnostic evidence only; never source truth, candidate color, resized raster, or palette output.
provenanceNotes: Retains parent mask identity, native dimensions, target attribution, low-pass filter identity, Q0.24 encoding, and plane hash.

artifactTypes.label: Target-lattice Q0.24 support samples
artifactTypes.description: The exact nearest-center subset sampled from a corresponding native Q0.24 low-pass plane onto a target lattice.
sourceNotes: This is a sampled derived field, not a working RGB raster and not an independently filtered plane.
provenanceNotes: Retains source indices, target dimensions, parent native plane and mask identities, exact equality checks, and typed hashes.

artifactTypes.label: Native mask scale-space custody diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Filter identity, mass residual, typed hashes, target attribution, exact-sampling checks, and explicit invalid states for one mask observation.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Record mechanical scale-space custody and residual checks without emitting or selecting a palette.
sourceNotes: The mechanism explicitly has no palette output and corpus vectors cannot be averaged into a winner.
provenanceNotes: Binds mask, target, SAT/BigInt implementation, Q0.24 policy, residual bounds, source indices, hashes, and validity state.

artifactTypes.label: Support topology threshold policy
artifactTypes.description: A declared threshold, connectivity, distance-transform, boundary, hole, enclosure, reach, and undefined-state policy.
sourceNotes: Topology over soft support is threshold-dependent; deferred metrics must not be emitted as placeholders.
provenanceNotes: Binds threshold, lattice, connectivity, scan order, transforms, normalization, and every undefined case.

artifactTypes.label: Support topology descriptor vector
artifactTypes.description: Component signatures and counts, largest mass, boundary density, side ownership, thickness, enclosure, reach, and explicit undefined values.
sourceNotes: Diagnostic geometry only; no field, frame, typography, or figure authority is conferred.
provenanceNotes: Retains input support identity, threshold, topology policy, exact normalization, component ordering, and undefined states.

artifactTypes.label: Robust field-fit configuration
artifactTypes.description: Declared flat, block, linear, and radial surface families with sampling, redescending loss, initialization, stopping, abstention, recursion, and resource policies.
sourceNotes: Required to make robust fitting behavior, alternatives, and cold-resource assumptions explicit.
provenanceNotes: Binds raster lattice, sampled pixels, surface family, robust loss, fit order, random state if any, stopping, and recursion.

artifactTypes.label: Fitted robust color-surface model
artifactTypes.description: One fitted flat, block, linear, or radial per-image color-surface model with parameters and source-lattice identity.
sourceNotes: A fitted per-image model output, not an external warm model and not field authority by itself.
provenanceNotes: Retains source samples, surface family, parameters, fit policy, explained fraction, fit order, and recursion lineage.

artifactTypes.label: Robust fit residual and inlier-weight fields
artifactTypes.description: Per-pixel residuals and redescending inlier weights for one fitted color surface.
sourceNotes: Residual is enriched for marks but is not a pure figure mask.
provenanceNotes: Retains fitted model identity, source lattice, residual metric, weight function, scale, and every pixel correspondence.

artifactTypes.label: P5 robust field model and residual aggregate
artifactTypes.description: The complete P5 fit aggregate containing fitted flat, block, linear, or radial model records, paired residual and inlier-weight fields, absolute explained fractions, alternatives, abstention, and recursion state.
sourceNotes: Aggregates exactly the P5 robust model, residual, inlier-weight, explained-fraction, abstention, and recursion outputs without asserting historical v2-3 GradientFitDiagnostic semantics.
provenanceNotes: Retains every model-to-residual pairing, selected sample lattice, scores, explained fractions, abstention reason, recursion, source identity, and resource observations.

artifactTypes.label: Residual mark-group hypotheses
artifactTypes.description: Zero or more groups of robust-fit rejections with span, mass, neighborhood, exact-color support, and residual provenance.
sourceNotes: Groups are figure-enriched hypotheses, not pure figures or UI role assignments.
provenanceNotes: Retains fitted model, residual and weight fields, grouping policy, native exact-color support, and empty result.

artifactTypes.label: Declared image channel family
artifactTypes.description: One or more scalar or chromatic image channels with a declared source, conversion, ordering, and lattice.
sourceNotes: Tree-of-shapes can consume an image or channel family; Section 3 does not define channel-family formation.
provenanceNotes: Binds source raster, channel formulas, ordering, dimensions, numeric encoding, and any chromatic-lane interpretation.

artifactTypes.label: Tree-of-shapes configuration
artifactTypes.description: Level-set, connectivity, channel-lane, attribute, representative, candidate-lane, and ordering policy for hierarchical shape extraction.
sourceNotes: Required to distinguish nested level-set hierarchy formation from ranking or role correctness.
provenanceNotes: Binds channel family, connectivity, level ordering, parent ties, attribute formulas, representatives, and lane generation.

artifactTypes.label: Rooted tree-of-shapes hierarchy
artifactTypes.description: A rooted nested level-set hierarchy with parent/child relations, node area, depth, shape attributes, and exact-pixel representative custody.
sourceNotes: Hierarchical candidate evidence can expose isoluminant marks but does not establish ranking or roles.
provenanceNotes: Retains source image or channel, level-set policy, deterministic hierarchy order, node attributes, and exact representative witness.

artifactTypes.label: Tree-of-shapes candidate lanes
artifactTypes.description: Candidate lanes read from hierarchy nodes at declared containment scales, including exact-pixel representatives.
sourceNotes: Reachability remains separate from assignment-set stability, ranking, and role correctness.
provenanceNotes: Retains hierarchy node, lane policy, containment scale, attributes, exact representative, and candidate ordering.

artifactTypes.label: Per-pixel rank-field policy
artifactTypes.description: Declared scalar field definitions, rank ordering, ties, requested role or hypothesis set, and exact-pixel publication rules.
sourceNotes: Field design and requested output identities remain consequential even though pixel availability is complete.
provenanceNotes: Binds field formulas, role/hypothesis requests, rank direction, ties, exclusions, and source-pixel witness policy.

artifactTypes.label: Per-pixel scalar rank evidence
artifactTypes.description: Several scalar fields and complete native-pixel rank orderings for declared roles or hypotheses.
sourceNotes: Complete availability does not establish field quality or role correctness.
provenanceNotes: Retains native raster, field definition, requested semantic identity, every score, ordering, and tie rule.

artifactTypes.label: Rank-published native role pixels
artifactTypes.description: Exactly one native pixel witness per requested role or hypothesis, collected with rank and field provenance.
sourceNotes: Exact-pixel publication is supported mechanically while role-field semantics remain inconclusive.
provenanceNotes: Each requested identity retains exact RGB, native index and coordinates, rank, scalar field, ties, and source hash.

artifactTypes.label: Multiscale surround policy
artifactTypes.description: Blur ladder, positional fields, anisotropy, habitual-ground, excursion, delayed-quantization, and exact-redemption policy.
sourceNotes: Continuous measurements are distinct from the falsified P6 weighted joint objective that consumed them.
provenanceNotes: Binds scales, kernels, positions, anisotropy, boundary handling, quantization delay, and source sample identity.

artifactTypes.label: Multiscale surround evidence collection
artifactTypes.description: Surround-at-scale fields, habitual-ground evidence, excursion profiles, and the continuous substrate before exact-pixel redemption.
sourceNotes: Preserves continuous evidence discarded by fixed-radius or early-bin mechanisms without solving exchange rates or role vocabulary.
provenanceNotes: Retains native samples, scale and position identities, each field and profile, continuous encoding, and deferred exact redemption.

artifactTypes.label: Extent-eligible native pixels
artifactTypes.description: A native-lattice eligibility mask supplied to octave-ladder area-integral extent measurement.
sourceNotes: Arm C's claimed input includes eligibility, but no portable Section 3 producer or contract is provided.
provenanceNotes: Must retain native raster identity, eligibility rule, mask hash, population, and any candidate or field attribution.

artifactTypes.label: Area-integral extent policy
artifactTypes.description: Declared octave windows, area-integral formula, top-quarter extent rule, field formation, ordering, and comparison policy.
sourceNotes: The exact excluded-worktree policy is nonportable archaeology and is not inherited as a validated contract.
provenanceNotes: Must bind octave windows, integral boundaries, eligibility, top-quarter rule, field set, ordering, and drift formulas.

artifactTypes.label: Frozen P3 extent comparison rows
artifactTypes.description: Reviewed or frozen development rows used as the P3 baseline for extent ordering drift comparisons.
sourceNotes: The portable repository does not provide the authoritative frozen P3 rows required by the archaeology claim.
provenanceNotes: Requires review/freeze identity, source cases, P3 substrate identity, row hashes, ordering fields, and custody status.

artifactTypes.label: Area-integral extent field
artifactTypes.description: The proposed octave-ladder area-integral extent values over eligible native pixels.
sourceNotes: Proposed output with unsupported inherited evidence and unmeasured portable custody.
provenanceNotes: Retains native raster, eligibility mask, octave policy, every extent value, lattice, and portable/nonportable custody state.

artifactTypes.label: Extent-derived field set and ordering
artifactTypes.description: An uncertain field set with extent-based ordering summaries and explicit empty or ambiguous states.
sourceNotes: Proposed Arm C field interpretation; no portable inherited result establishes it.
provenanceNotes: Retains extent field, eligibility, top-quarter rule, ordering ties, field identities, and uncertainty.

artifactTypes.label: Area-integral extent drift diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Ordering summaries and rendition/same-resolution drift ratios against frozen P3 rows.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Expose portable or nonportable comparison outcomes without converting archaeology into inherited evidence.
sourceNotes: Must distinguish absent portable results from excluded-worktree figures.
provenanceNotes: Retains frozen-row review identity, comparison cohort, perturbation identity, ratio formulas, missing states, and custody classification.

artifactTypes.label: Global additive-noise scale estimate
artifactTypes.description: One global noise standard-deviation estimate with the fixed 3x3 high-pass filter identity.
sourceNotes: A global noise magnitude, not a local texture mask, shading classifier, or semantic field gate.
provenanceNotes: Retains scalar plane, filter coefficients, boundary policy, normalization, dimensions, and invalid small-image states.

artifactTypes.label: Grayscale max-tree
artifactTypes.description: A connected grayscale component hierarchy suitable for attribute area openings.
sourceNotes: Alternative morphology input; no Section 3 mechanism constructs the max-tree.
provenanceNotes: Must bind scalar plane, connectivity, level ordering, node identity, parent ties, area, and boundary policy.

artifactTypes.label: Area-granulometry scales
artifactTypes.description: An ordered set of component-area thresholds with resolution normalization, connectivity, and null behavior.
sourceNotes: Area scale defines removed detail and can erase fine typography; no normalized policy is selected.
provenanceNotes: Binds ordered thresholds, units, normalization, connectivity, polarity, and empty-domain behavior.

artifactTypes.label: Area-opened grayscale planes
artifactTypes.description: Grayscale planes after connected area openings at each declared ordered area scale.
sourceNotes: Surviving connected components are not geometrically deformed by the area opening claim.
provenanceNotes: Retains source plane or max-tree, scale order, component identities, removed nodes, reconstruction policy, and lattice.

artifactTypes.label: Area-granulometry response
artifactTypes.description: Removed-component provenance and the response distribution across ordered area scales.
sourceNotes: Descriptor output only; no automatic texture, field, figure, or typography authority.
provenanceNotes: Retains each scale, removed component, mass difference, normalization, distribution bins, and null cases.

artifactTypes.label: Texture descriptor policy
artifactTypes.description: Declared quantization, offsets, orientations, radii, neighborhood, boundary, aggregation, and histogram policies for local texture statistics.
sourceNotes: Parameters distinguish co-occurrence and binary-pattern formulations and remain unresolved.
provenanceNotes: Binds descriptor family, scalar/color conversion, quantization, offsets, radii, orientation pooling, boundaries, and output normalization.

artifactTypes.label: Local or region-level texture descriptors
artifactTypes.description: Contrast, homogeneity, entropy, and pattern histograms for declared local neighborhoods or regions.
sourceNotes: Descriptor similarity does not determine whether typography, halftone, grain, or other material belongs to a field.
provenanceNotes: Retains source plane, spatial support, descriptor policy, every histogram or scalar, scale, orientation, and aggregation scope.

artifactTypes.label: Pixel adjacency graph
artifactTypes.description: A declared pixel graph with node-to-native-pixel identity and deterministic edge ordering.
sourceNotes: One FH merge input alternative; pixel-graph construction is not a Section 3 mechanism.
provenanceNotes: Must retain native raster, neighborhood connectivity, edge endpoints, boundary handling, and deterministic equal-edge order.

artifactTypes.label: Graph edge dissimilarities
artifactTypes.description: One declared dissimilarity value per edge of a compatible pixel or region graph.
sourceNotes: FH merging requires edge dissimilarities, but Section 3 does not define their computation for either graph alternative.
provenanceNotes: Must bind graph identity, edge order, color or region attributes, formula, units, ties, and nonfinite handling.

artifactTypes.label: Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher merge policy
artifactTypes.description: The k value, internal-difference update, nondecreasing edge order, equality behavior, and minimum-size cleanup policy.
sourceNotes: Graph construction, k, cleanup, and equal-edge ordering are consequential and no policy is selected.
provenanceNotes: Binds graph and edge identities, k, merge inequality, component-size terms, internal differences, cleanup, and ordering.

artifactTypes.label: FH graph partition
artifactTypes.description: A node-to-component partition resulting from size-adaptive nondecreasing-edge graph merging.
sourceNotes: Partition output has no field or figure labels.
provenanceNotes: Retains input graph nodes, final component IDs, deterministic ordering, merge policy, and minimum-size cleanup effects.

artifactTypes.label: FH merge trace and diagnostics
artifactTypes.description: Ordered accepted merges, component internal differences, rejected edges, thresholds, and cleanup actions.
sourceNotes: Makes the unbuilt rule inspectable without claiming human utility or semantic labels.
provenanceNotes: Retains graph, edge dissimilarities, sorted order, every comparison term, merge decision, internal-difference update, and cleanup.

censusStatus.authorizationText: `inventory-only`; this census entry grants no selection, composition, funding, or product authority.
censusStatus.statusText: scientific interpretation `supported` mechanically and `inconclusive` semantically; implementation state `live`; evidence scope `mechanical`; runtime admissibility `permitted`.

inputPorts.label: Ordered packed RGB color-count observations
notes: Distinct observation order affects first-distinct-color initialization and publication ties.

inputPorts.label: Color-space distance
notes: Assignment and nearest-observed publication use this distance while updates average packed RGB channels.

inputPorts.label: Requested cluster count
notes: Effective k can be smaller when insufficient distinct colors are found.

outputPorts.label: Returned observed-color population map
valueStateNotes: Can contain fewer entries than effective k when representatives collide as Map keys.
Invalid numeric state can arise after an empty-cluster division by zero.
notes: This public output omits memberships and synthesized mean centers.

outputPorts.label: Normalized WCSS and effective k
valueStateNotes: WCSS is population-normalized and may be invalid if cluster state contains invalid means.
